INDIGENOUS: Manitoba appointed Canada's first associate justice dedicated to reconciliation. stories.title: Carney government eliminating CORE -- the watchdog overseeing Canadian companies operating abroad
stories.summary: The federal government confirmed it is eliminating the Canadian Ombudsperson for Responsible Enterprise (CORE), the office created in 2019 to investigate alleged human-rights abuses linked to Canadian companies (mining, garment, oil and gas) operating overseas. Abolishing CORE removes the only dedicated federal mechanism for scrutinizing the overseas conduct of Canadian corporations, at a moment when the government is also winding down other oversight bodies.
stories.connection: DIRECTLY on-mission oversight-dismantlement thread. CORE's remit (Canadian companies operating abroad) overlaps the arms-export accountability work in arms_exports_israel.json and arms_pipeline_dossier.json -- defence/extractive firms exporting or operating overseas would lose an independent complaints channel. Pattern-matches the executive-accountability framing of the climate-litigation thread in brief_20260617 (statutory watchdogs being removed/weakened). Recommend opening an 'oversight_dismantlement' tracker and cross-referencing officer_of_parliament_findings.json.

stories.title: Bill C-30 passes, giving cabinet power to authorize pesticides Health Canada deemed unsafe -- no committee study
stories.summary: Before Parliament rose for the summer, the Carney government passed Bill C-30, which grants cabinet the power to authorize use of pesticides that Health Canada has assessed as unsafe. The health minister's office framed the powers as protecting 'successful harvests' and 'food sovereignty.' Scientists, public-health and environmental experts were not given the chance to testify; the health and environment committees did not study the legislation. The NDP and Green Party condemned the move as pushing sweeping powers through without scrutiny.
stories.connection: NEW governance / rule-of-law-process thread: executive (cabinet) assumes a discretionary power to override a regulator's safety determination, with Parliamentary scrutiny bypassed -- the same regulatory-capture vs. independent-enforcement pattern tracked in financial_crime_policy_2026.json and procurement_anomalies.json. Pairs with the CORE abolition as a two-item 'oversight bypass' cluster this week. Flag for a health/regulatory-accountability watch entry.

stories.title: Correctional Service Canada confirms 27-year-old man died at Atlantic Institution
stories.summary: Correctional Service Canada said Ryan Richard, 27, died on Wednesday at the Atlantic Institution in New Brunswick, releasing few details about the circumstances. As with all federal in-custody deaths, an investigation and (where applicable) a coroner's process is expected.

stories.title: Doug Ford 'Four Seasons' jail remark amid Kevin Mamakwa in-custody death inquest
stories.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford drew criticism for comparing the planned Thunder Bay Correctional Centre to a 'Four Seasons Hotel.' The comments came during the inquest into the death of Kevin Mamakwa, who died in the old Thunder Bay jail in 2020. The remark intersects a live Indigenous death-in-custody accountability process.
stories.connection: Cross-references corrections_accountability_dossier.json and indigenous_accountability_dossier.json -- Indigenous death in custody plus a sitting premier minimizing carceral conditions during the inquest. Complements the same-week federal CSC death item; together they support a 'custodial-conditions accountability' sub-thread spanning federal and Ontario jurisdictions.

stories.title: Manitoba appoints Canada's first associate justice dedicated to reconciliation
stories.summary: A Manitoba judge was appointed to a first-of-its-kind associate justice role focused on reconciliation, intended to improve relationships between the courts and Indigenous communities. A structural, institution-building development on the Crown-Indigenous file.
stories.connection: Positive-direction counterpoint within the Indigenous-accountability theme (judicial_accountability_dossier.json / indigenous_accountability_dossier.json). Low direct investigative weight but logged as an institutional reform data point against which to measure later outcomes.
